Leah (Docs): Heads-up: Legal wants a softer deprecation path for /v1/invoke so we avoid breaking regulated customers. Planning: 3-stage sunset (opt-in flag -> parallel support -> hard sunset). Need docs + runbook for each stage by Wed.

Omar (Eng): Strong +1. Implementation plan: we add `X-Compat-Mode: v1` header that toggles compatibility layer. Stage 1 = opt-in (customers enable header to get v1 behavior); Stage 2 = requests without header get 307 redirect with guidance; Stage 3 = 410 for non-header POSTs. We'll keep a compatibility shim running for 8 weeks after Stage 1 for telemetry.

Leah (Docs): Good. For the guide, I'll write three short sections: "Quick opt-in", "Parallel testing checklist", "Hard-sunset checklist". Can someone paste the exact header name and an example curl?

Omar (Eng): Header: X-Compat-Mode: v1. Example curl for opt-in:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Compat-Mode: v1" \
  -d '{"model_id":"rwd-base","input":"Translate: Hola"}'
```
Note the shim will also accept `model_id` and translate to `model` internally.

Priya (Security): Quick security note: the header will be logged in request metadata. We need a one-line privacy blurb in the docs and confirm logs are access-controlled. Carlos, can you confirm retention for header values in prod logs?

Carlos (Ops): Logs currently keep headers for 30 days and only SRE+Sec teams have access. We can redact header values after Stage 2 if Legal prefers. I'll add a section in runbook: how to redact and how to grant emergency access.

Leah (Docs): Nice. Also want to include a short metrics query customers can run to find impacted endpoints. Any suggested Datadog/Grafana query?

Omar (Eng): Use this Datadog log query (approx):
```
logs("service:api AND path:/v1/invoke AND status:>=400").rollup("count").by("host")
```
And this for usage volume:
```
sum:api.request.count{path:/v1/invoke}.rollup(sum, 3600)
```
Put a copy-paste ready snippet in the doc.

Nina (Customer Success): For CS playbook: include a quick triage flow: 1) ask if they use private/Dedicated, 2) check for pinned SDK versions, 3) offer to flip `X-Compat-Mode: v1` for 2 weeks, 4) schedule migration call. I'll add canned messages once docs draft is live.

Leah (Docs): I'll add CS canned messages and a template email for the staged rollout. Also adding a tiny JS shim users can drop into server middleware to add header for legacy clients: 
```js
// middleware to set compat header for legacy clients
function compatMiddleware(req, res, next) {
  if(req.headers['x-legacy-client'] === 'true') {
    req.headers['x-compat-mode'] = 'v1'
  }
  next()
}
```

Omar (Eng): QA checklist suggestion: smoke tests for (a) shim translating `model_id` to `model`, (b) streaming shape compatibility, (c) auth unchanged. I'll open a test PR with concrete tests.

Leah (Docs): Please open the PR and paste link here. Also need a short note explaining streaming differences so customers can decide whether to opt-in. Omar, can you summarize change?

Omar (Eng): Streaming shape: v1 emitted objects like `{token: "foo"}`; v2 emits `{delta: "foo", metadata:{chunk:1}}`. With compat header we emit a v1-shaped envelope for the stream. Add a note about slight latency increase (~5-10ms) when using compat shim.

Priya (Security): Confirming that compat shim does not change auth scopes. If we detect any scope differences we must flag. Omar, verify.

Omar (Eng): Confirmed: no scope change. Same auth checks run upstream.

Leah (Docs): Timeline: draft by Tue EOD, reviews Wed (ops/security/CS/eng), publish Thu. Can everyone review PRs within 24h?

Carlos (Ops): I'll review runbook and add incident steps + redact playbook by Wed noon.

Nina (Customer Success): CS review will be done Wed afternoon; I'll add migration calendar and outreach template.

Omar (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/923 — includes header support, shim, and unit tests.

Leah (Docs): Thanks — linking PR in draft. DocsBot: created draft PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2821 (soft-sunset-invoke).

Leah (Docs): If no objections I'll proceed with the draft language that emphasizes opt-in, telemetry, and redaction options. We should avoid implying indefinite support for v1.

Priya (Security): No objections. Please add the privacy blurb: "X-Compat-Mode header may be retained in logs up to 30 days; contact security@redwood.com for access requests."

Leah (Docs): Added. Thanks team — will ping when draft is ready for review.
